If you are bleeding and the companion is within 6 m, he bandages you. Uses a bandage from his backpack if he has one. Cooldown 180 s.\n"A hundred grams": if radiation is hitting you (second step of the icon or more) and there is no fight, he pours you vodka from his backpack; with none left he finds a bottle in his personal stock once per 6 game hours. Vodka works as usual: removes radiation and makes you drunk. Cooldown 180 s.

If your health is below 40% and the companion is within 6 m, he applies a medkit from his backpack to you himself (he takes back what is left of a multi-use kit). With no medkits he uses a basic one from his personal stock once per 12 game hours. Cooldown 90 s.\nAt heavy radiation (35% or more), out of combat, he gives you an antirad from his backpack or, with none left, from his personal stock once per 12 game hours. Cooldown 120 s. Vodka is poured only when there is no antirad.\nThe drugs work as usual.

You can be knocked down instead of dying: if the Reanimator is alive, on his feet and within 50 m, a lethal hit puts you down for 60 s. He runs to you and comes right up to you, kneels and in 8 s gets you up with 35% health.
After that the perk is on cooldown for 4 game hours: go down again in that time and you die. Nobody came in time - you die as well.
He revives companions the same way: 8 s within 15 m, 50% health, cooldown 120 s (needs the Companion Downed But Not Out mod).
Excludes the Field Surgeon perk.

A companion gets perk points for levels; how many is set in MCM (default: 1 point per level and one more at levels 4, 7 and 10, 12 in total). A tier costs as many points as its number: 1, 2 and 3. Tier three is a choice between two perks; the Carrier and the Medic have no choice, and the Medic's Reanimator is a separate perk whose cost is set in MCM.\nExperience comes from kills, kills made near the companion, survived emissions, tasks you complete and time in the squad.

Needs an artefact detector in the companion's backpack (Echo, Bear, Grizzly, Veles or Svarog).\nArtefacts around the companion get a yellow dot on the minimap and in the PDA, and he reports distance and direction.\nRadius by detector: Echo 15 m, Bear and Grizzly 25 m, Veles 35 m, Svarog 50 m.

Search radius x1.5, the message and the mark name the artefact.\nIf an artefact is within 15 m of the companion and there is no fight, he gets it out in 20 s and puts it into his own backpack. Condition of the extracted artefact +5%.\nCooldown 30 game minutes.

Search radius x2, extracts artefacts from 25 m, cooldown 15 game minutes.\nCondition of the extracted artefact +5%. 15% chance to find a second artefact of the same kind.\nExcludes the Connoisseur perk.

Search radius x1.5. Careful extraction: condition of the extracted artefact +15%.\nArtefacts and artefact containers in his backpack regain 1% condition per game hour, up to 60%.\nExcludes the Prospector perk.

The Reanimator perk (you can be knocked down and the companion revives you) can be bought without Medic tiers, even at companion level 1. If disabled it needs Medic tier two, and an already bought perk sleeps until then. The Medic branch must be enabled.
How many points the perk costs. A bought perk remembers what was paid: a reset returns exactly that (bought before this version - 4 points).
